general_question.question: Does GOV-FROZEN-1 need a recognised route such as control_waived_with_basis for legs resolved by ratified disposition with no adjudicating run?
general_question.answer: NO -- no schema or checker change.
general_question.basis: Once sub-case 2 exits the class, the only instances of the shape are the two MECH-467 superseded legs, one event, already ruled by GFLAG-0303 item 3 (standing advisory accepted, control_passed stays false). GOV-HELDOUT-1 cannot find 3 non-degenerate historical cases where a waiver route and the current rule give different answers, which is itself the finding: a waiver route would be scoped to one incident. superseded was deliberately placed in CONTROL_REQUIRED_STATES (REE_assembly a74f644753, 2026-08-19). A permissive waiver would also let a confirmed (load-bearing) leg be ratified past its control, which is the GOV-FROZEN-1 Goodhart direction. Revisit only if a further non-degenerate case arrives.
general_question.heldout_record: GOV-HELDOUT-1: no standing rule or checker changed, so no held-out check is owed for shipping. The check was used as the decision instrument: across the registry's confirmed/superseded legs (52 at 2026-09-23), the only legs a waiver route would treat differently from the current rule are the two MECH-467 superseded legs (one event, 2026-09-16, already ruled); sub-case 2 leaves the class once corrected. Fewer than 3 non-degenerate cases -> a route would be scoped to its motivating incident -> not built.
